Use case: precise-object-edit. Intended use: production 2D browser-game WALK animation, not concept art. Edit the provided TRANSPARENT REFERENCE CANVAS into ONE complete horizontal strip of EXACTLY SIX animation frames. Keep output 1536 by1536 pixels, and place the six equal 256px square frame slots in ONE ROW from x=0 to1536, y=640 to896. The existing leftmost character is the approved in-game seed and is the identity/scale authority. Keep frame1 identical as the contact pose. Draw frames2-6 using the exact same character: left-facing cream-white and charcoal saddle-marked fantasy weasel, gold eyes, large curled bushy white tail, same low crouching proportions, same outline/light/shading/fur and face. Preserve same head size, body length and tail volume across every frame. Keep body centered at same horizontal point within each slot; paws use a common ground line with controlled small weight shifts. Leave all space outside the six sprites genuinely transparent, no glow/gray haze/drop shadow/background, no text, no grid, no labels.
Animate a clearly readable natural FOUR-LEGGED WALK with new silhouettes, visible knee/elbow bending and distinct paw placements, NOT tiny warping of the idle. Frame1 near forepaw planted forward(left), far forepaw behind; opposite hindpaw supports. Frame5 opposite passing pose with one front paw bent/raised; rear paw advances under hip. Frame6 next reach to close smoothly back to frame1. At every pose at least two paws support the mass. Front feet reach visibly forward/back by about15% of body length; flex the joints rather than stretching paws. Small shoulder/hip rise and delayed tail curl follow-through. No jumping, no entire-image wobble, no changing markings, no different character. This is HD painterly outlined sprite art matching the seed, NOT pixel art. Draw the entire six-frame gait in this single edit pass.
note: Complete frames from one generation, preserved individually. The earlier parts atlas is retained as a superseded preparation artifact; the final animation uses the whole drawn strip.
